However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders must operate a registered office within Kerala and possess a valid Goods and Services T ax (GST) registration number issued by the Government of India. The GST number must be current and active. Additionally, a valid office license in accordance with local laws in Kerala is req uired. Supporting documentation must be included for verification. • 2. Bidders must declare on company letter head that their firm has not been blacklisted or debarre d from participating in any government or public sector procurement processes within the last five years. 3. The bidder should have a minimum of 5 years or above of experience in the supply with its regi stered office in Kerala • 4. As per standing order , whenever a vacant post of MTS is filled by a permane nt staff, the corresponding strength of contractual manpower of the respective category should be reduced proportionately, and terminated the hired staff wit h a notice period of one month. .
